title: Dataset for Tabular OCV modeling
description: Battery terminal voltage and current recorded during the OCV-SOC characterization process of a Li-ion Samsung 30T-INR21700 cell. Includes Arbin cycler data and a reproducible CC-CV charge and C/30 discharge/charge OCV test procedure for developing OCV-SOC models and tabular OCV representations.
citation: Sundaresan, Sneha; Devabattini, Bharath C.; Kumar, Pradeep; Pattipati, Krishna; Balasingam, Balakumar (2022), “Dataset for Tabular OCV modeling”, Mendeley Data, V1, doi: 10.17632/m9w7grpjc7.1
